title: Icon
description: The semantic icon registry (stroke 1.75, 24px grid). IconTile is the rounded tinted square that leads cards and dialogs.
when: Every icon in the UI: pick the semantic name (trash = delete, close = dismiss, refresh = reload). See docs/ICONS.md.

instead.use: add it to ICONS in @semi/ui (/semi-propose), never an inline <svg>

a11y: Decorative by default (aria-hidden); pass title when the icon alone carries meaning.
